en: A colored vintage postcard view showing an ornate Ottoman baroque fountain with multiple small domes and finials in the foreground, and to the left a large stone gate or wall section of a fortification. Behind them is a waterfront with the sea or a strait and a distant shoreline covered with low hills and buildings. At the bottom margin, printed captions in red identify the location as Constantinople and specify the Sultan Ahmed fountain in French.
